# GEO-DRIFT-UPDATE B1 — the field unit's entire dependency list.
#
# ★ TWO PACKAGES. The drift monitor is template matching plus one 3x3 SVD; it
#   needs no torch, no ultralytics, no GPU, and no geospatial stack. If a third
#   line ever appears here, something has been imported that does not belong on
#   an embedded box.
#
# ★ HEADLESS ON PURPOSE. A field unit has no display, and the plain
#   `opencv-python` wheel drags in GUI libraries that will not install on a
#   minimal image. The CONTRIB build is NOT needed here: that one exists for the
#   CSRT tracker used by detection, which this daemon never touches.
#
# ★ ARM / Raspberry Pi: prefer the OS packages, which are prebuilt --
#       sudo apt install python3-numpy python3-opencv
#   and skip the venv entirely, or create it with --system-site-packages so it
#   can see them. Building numpy or OpenCV from source on a Pi takes hours.
numpy>=1.24
opencv-python-headless>=4.8
